ambiguity.rule: Is essential context missing or text ambiguous enough to require human review of topic, intent, severity, or sentiment?

criteria.cancellation: Explicit personal leaving/uninstalling/cancelling or threat thereof.
criteria.complaint: Negative experience, including mixed praise/criticism or generic bad-app criticism.
criteria.praise: Positive; no higher-precedence intent.
criteria.request: Desired change without reported failure.
criteria.unclear: Unrelated/meaningless or bare boycott slogan without product complaint/personal departure.

intent.rule: Precedence: cancellation > complaint > request > praise > unclear. Bare boycott slogans are unclear unless product complaint or explicit personal departure.

sentiment.rule: Overall sentiment toward the product expressed in the review.

criteria.1: No reported problem: praise/neutral/unclear/pure feature request.
criteria.2: Dislike/generic criticism/minor annoyance/cosmetic issue; no supported functional loss.
criteria.3: Degraded/restricted function; some use/workaround remains.
criteria.4: Clearly blocked core task, e.g. cannot log in/play music.
criteria.5: Explicit serious financial/privacy/data harm; expensive plan/crash/anger alone insufficient.

severity.rule: Highest explicitly supported impact. Cancellation/anger does not automatically raise severity; do not invent missing impact.

criteria.access: Login/signup/password/account access.
criteria.billing: Price/charges/subscriptions/paywalls/Premium entitlement; explicitly Premium-only controls.
criteria.catalog: Missing songs or artists/search/discovery/recommendations/lyrics availability.
criteria.downloads: Downloading/saved music/offline listening/disappearing downloads.
criteria.other: General praise/criticism, unrelated, or no supported specific topic.
criteria.playback: Playback failure/crash/lag/connection failure/audio quality/resource use.
criteria.support: Contacting support or its response.
criteria.usability: Navigation/controls/layout/queue or playlist management/ad interruptions.

topic.rule: Highest-supported-severity problem; ties: first specific problem mentioned. Positive review: first specific praised feature. Paid-plan mention alone is not billing; subscription activation failure is billing, crashes for a paying customer are playback.

criteria.2: Dislike/generic criticism/minor annoyance/cosmetic issue; no supported functional loss.
criteria.3: Degraded/restricted function; some use/workaround remains.
criteria.4: Clearly blocked core task, e.g. cannot log in/play music.

criteria.other: General praise/criticism, unrelated, or no supported specific topic.
criteria.playback: Playback failure/crash/lag/connection failure/audio quality/resource use.
criteria.support: Contacting support or its response.
criteria.usability: Navigation/controls/layout/queue or playlist management/ad interruptions.
